tcm.note: Served iced = cold-damp burden in TCM's view; the drink itself isn't classical.

histamine.note: Caffeinated and sweet, but caffeine does not inhibit DAO — SIGHI marks no mechanism on cola.

stimulant.note: Modest caffeine and a great deal of sugar; the crash people describe is mostly the sugar.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
